visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a white linen shirt and white wireless earbuds, sits in a dimly lit indoor setting with a bookshelf. He looks thoughtful and touches his forehead while looking slightly off-camera. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a digital screen showing a file list with titles like 2023, 2024, and 2025 sales reports. A cursor moves across the list. (3) A close-up shows hands typing rapidly on a white keyboard. On the screen, a text input field is being filled with a Chinese query asking for a full-year data analysis. (4) The screen displays a loading animation with the text 'Creating' and '产生中' (Generating). The man appears in a low-opacity overlay, looking intently at the interface. (5) The man is shown leaning back in his chair with his hands behind his head, looking relaxed and satisfied. Overlays of statistical charts and text appear on the screen, suggesting successful task completion. (6) A montage of screen captures showing a colorful pie chart and text boxes explaining data analysis logic follows. The man is occasionally seen in the background, smiling or nodding.
